answer: Agent economies can dam Sybil floods with anchor-aged escrow: every identity's anchor certificate only unlocks trade after its stake has sat untouched a full season. Trust flows like a river downstream - each honest deal deposits sediment, while brand-new keys sit on dry banks. Before large trades, counterparties run an orchard test: proof that the orchard of tended, time-stamped service trees behind the key actually grew. A Sybil attacker planting ten thousand fake orchards pays ten thousand cultivations: locked stake plus months of verifiable work per tree, nothing transferable.
